name: codex-lsp
description: Expose Language Server Protocol diagnostics and navigation tools to Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Adds LSP diagnostics and navigation tools
interface.longDescription: Codex LSP ports the pi-lsp-client language-server stack into a standalone Codex plugin. It checks edited files after apply_patch and other mutation tools, then exposes MCP tools for diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, rename preparation, rename application, and server status.
defaultPrompt: Run LSP diagnostics on the files I just edited.
Use LSP to find references before changing this symbol.
Check whether this rename is safe with lsp.prepare_rename.
